definitions.gloss: acceleration; rate of change of velocity
definitions.explanation: A physics term for the rate at which the speed of an object changes over time. Also used figuratively to describe the increasing pace of change.

examples.japanese: {加速度|かそくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}する→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧。
⟦{重力|じゅうりょく}→重力：25301_juuryoku⟧{加速度|かそくど}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧9.8m/s²だ。

⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}{革新|かくしん}→技術革新：12892_gijutsukakushin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{加速度|かそくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ま}して→増す：02422_masu⟧⟦{進|すす}んで→進む：01225_susumu⟧おり、⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ますます→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧⟦{速|はや}く→速い：00514_hayai⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Technological innovation is accelerating, and social change is getting faster and faster.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{加速|かそく}→加速：00198_kasoku⟧ (acceleration, speeding up) + ⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (degree, rate). Primarily a physics term, but also used in figurative contexts to describe processes that are speeding up.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{重力|じゅうりょく}→重力：25301_juuryoku⟧{加速度|かそくど}: gravitational acceleration
- {加速度|かそくど}⟦センサー→センサー：29781_sensaa⟧: accelerometer
- {加速度|かそくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ま}す→増す：02422_masu⟧: to increase in acceleration
- {加速度|かそくど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく: to gain momentum
- {加速度|かそくど}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: at an accelerating rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{加速|かそく}→加速：00198_kasoku⟧: acceleration, speeding up — the act of accelerating, without the quantitative nuance
- ⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧: speed, velocity — the rate of movement itself, not its change
- ⟦{減速|げんそく}→減速：13336_gensoku_deceleration⟧: deceleration — the opposite, slowing down
